svg.aria-label: The LC86G on the same 3 g flight in Normal and Balloon mode. Balloon mode reports the climb rate and altitude of the boost; Normal mode reports a climb rate near zero for the first eighteen seconds, stops all output at 500 metres per second, and never publishes a valid fix again.
svg.text: climb rate through the 3 g boost (m/s)
500 m/s: both modes stop ALL output
Normal (orange) reads near zero for 18 s
while the vehicle climbs to 320 m/s
80 km: Balloon stops all output (its own altitude)
Normal (as shipped): reported, valid fixes only
